notes: לָמָּה → *why* fuses under rule 30, headed on the interrogative that carries the wh-lexeme.
The לְ of the recast infinitive takes the complementizer *that* while the dummy *there* and the modal *should* stay with the infinitive (rules 48, 52).
*to day* is one rendering of the article and its noun, headed on the noun (rule 30).
